findings.detail: The question calls the reviewer 'Claude Code' in the first sentence and 'the review bot' in the third sentence. One actor gets two names, so a reader may wonder whether the review bot is a separate tool. Use one name, for example 'muted the Claude Code review entirely'.

blind_answer.reason: Naming conventions has a 68% false-positive rate, and that category is eroding trust in the accurate ones (4.1-K3). The fix is to temporarily disable it, keep the low-FP security and null-handling categories active, and re-enable naming once its rewritten criteria pass testing (4.1-S2). A disables the most accurate category. C relies on 'be conservative', which does not improve precision (4.1-K2). D broadens a category that is already noisy.
